Cornerstone Advisors (“Cornerstone”), a leading management and technology consultancy serving banks, credit unions, and fintechs, today announced the appointment of Mazen Ghalayini as Chief Executive Officer and Chairman.

Ghalayini succeeds Cornerstone CEO and co-founder Steve Williams, who is transitioning to Founding Partner, effective immediately. Moving from his position as President, in his new role as CEO Ghalayini will lead the firm’s strategic direction, operations and continued investment in delivering advisory services, research, and technology insights to financial institutions navigating a rapidly evolving industry, providing the client-centric culture that has defined Cornerstone for more than two decades.

As Founding Partner, Williams will expand his focus on advising clients, cultivating strategic client relationships, and representing Cornerstone across the financial services industry. During his tenure as CEO, Williams helped build Cornerstone into a leading advisory firm for fast-scaling banks, credit unions, and fintechs that are leaning into strategic transformation.

The leadership change, effective immediately, positions Ghalayini to oversee Cornerstone’s strategic direction, operations and continued investment in advisory services, research and technology consulting for banks, credit unions and fintech companies navigating a rapidly changing financial services landscape.

Advisory firms serving the banking sector have increasingly expanded their capabilities to help clients manage technology investments, operational efficiency and long-term growth strategies. “It’s a privilege to build on the incredible foundation Steve and our team have created over the last 25 years,” Ghalayini said. “Cornerstone has earned the trust of financial institutions by helping them navigate change with practical, forward-looking advice.

In his new role as founding partner, Williams will focus on client advisory work, strategic relationships and representing the firm across the financial services industry. “This transition is a natural evolution for Cornerstone and demonstrates the strength of our leadership team,” Williams said.

Edgecombe brings more than 30 years of executive leadership experience across global manufacturing, engineered products, and distribution businesses. He joins Cornerstone from Tensar, a division of Commercial Metals Company (NYSE: CMC), where he served as global CEO and managing director, overseeing worldwide operations, manufacturing, sales, marketing, engineering, and business integration.

“Cornerstone has earned its position by becoming a trusted advisor — by doing the work right, project after project, for nearly three decades,” said Edgecombe. “What drew me here is the combination of real manufacturing capability, a national service footprint, and a culture built on integrity.
